info.summary: Batch 651 — AI correctness audit and audit-trail gaps: one confidence scale, listed options only, real model recorded, rule-based mismatch, OPCS-4 sample, narrative provenance, pool/delegation/team/comment/dictionary/language/deficiency audit entries
info.description: Vitest, 2026-10-23: full suite 1767 files, 14,789 tests (14,777 passed; the one explicit-any guard failure found in that run has since been fixed). Type-check clean. Targeted run of the 17 test files listed here (changed in Batches 650 to 652): all passed.
